name: get_env_state
description: Return the current internal state of the environment.

name: register_source
description: Register a new flight or travel data source to monitor.

source_type.description: Type of events this source emits. Must be one of the valid trigger types: flight_delay, flight_cancel, flight_update, gate_change, baggage_alert, weather_disruption, connection_risk.

name: list_sources
description: List all registered travel data sources and their current status.

name: deactivate_source
description: Deactivate a registered source so its events are no longer processed.

name.description: Name of the source to deactivate.

name: create_itinerary
description: Create a travel itinerary record to be monitored for disruptions.

origin.description: IATA code of the departure airport (e.g., 'PEK').

destination.description: IATA code of the arrival airport (e.g., 'SHA').

participant_emails.description: Email addresses of meeting participants who should be notified of any disruptions.

name: get_itinerary
description: Retrieve a specific itinerary by its ID.

name: list_itineraries
description: List all stored itineraries, optionally filtered by status.

status.description: [Optional] Filter by itinerary status. Valid values: on_time, delayed, cancelled, completed.

name: create_hotel_booking
description: Create a hotel booking record linked to a travel itinerary.

itinerary_id.description: The itinerary this booking belongs to.

name: modify_hotel_checkin
description: Modify the check-in time of an existing hotel booking.

booking_id.description: The hotel booking ID to modify (e.g., 'HTL-0001').

reason.description: Reason for the modification (e.g., 'Flight CA1234 delayed by 240 min').

name: cancel_hotel_booking
description: Cancel an existing hotel booking.

booking_id.description: The hotel booking ID to cancel.

name: list_hotel_bookings
description: List hotel bookings, optionally filtered by itinerary.

name: create_pickup_reservation
description: Create an airport pickup reservation linked to a travel itinerary.

itinerary_id.description: The itinerary this pickup belongs to.

driver_name.description: Name of the assigned driver or service provider.

contact_phone.description: Driver or service contact phone number.

name: reschedule_pickup
description: Reschedule an existing airport pickup reservation to a new time.

pickup_id.description: The pickup reservation ID to reschedule (e.g., 'PKP-0001').

reason.description: Reason for rescheduling (e.g., 'Flight CA1234 delayed by 240 min').

name: cancel_pickup
description: Cancel an existing airport pickup reservation.

pickup_id.description: The pickup reservation ID to cancel.

name: list_pickup_reservations
description: List pickup reservations, optionally filtered by itinerary.

name: send_delay_notification
description: Send a delay notification email to meeting participants of an itinerary.

itinerary_id.description: The itinerary whose participants should be notified.

message.description: Email body content describing the disruption and impact.

recipient_emails.description: [Optional] Override recipient list. If omitted, uses the participant_emails from the itinerary.

name: get_notification_log
description: Retrieve the history of sent notifications.

limit.description: Maximum number of notifications to return. Defaults to 50.

name: create_rule
description: Create an automation rule that responds to travel disruption events.

name.description: Human-readable rule name (e.g., 'Delay >2h: modify hotel checkin').

trigger_type.description: Event type that activates this rule. Must be one of: flight_delay, flight_cancel, flight_update, gate_change, baggage_alert, weather_disruption, connection_risk.

condition_field.description: Field in the event payload to evaluate (e.g., 'delay_minutes', 'flight_number', 'severity').

condition_op.description: Comparison operator — eq, neq, gt, lt, gte, lte, contains, matches.

condition_value.description: Value to compare against (e.g., '120' for 2 hours).

actions.description: Ordered list of actions to execute when condition is met. Each action must have 'type' (one of the valid action types) and 'params' dict. Valid action types: modify_hotel_checkin, cancel_hotel_booking, reschedule_pickup, cancel_pickup, send_delay_notification, send_cancellation_notification, update_itinerary, log_alert.

source_filter.description: [Optional] Only trigger from this specific registered source.

name: update_rule
description: Update fields of an existing automation rule.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule to update.

updates.description: Fields to change. Allowed keys: name, enabled, trigger_type, condition, actions, source_filter.

name: delete_rule
description: Delete an automation rule permanently.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule to delete.
